name: @hms/api-tests
description: API test automation (Postman collections executed headlessly via Newman) for the Hospital Management System (HMS) API gateway.

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:rbac
scripts.test:deployed: npm run pretest && newman run collections/hms-api.postman_collection.json -e environments/deployed.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,junit --reporter-junit-export newman/hms-api.junit.xml
